entry.fallback: On June 23, Chicago had matched a whole season of wins. Win 42 came on June 26. By August 9, Chicago had passed 2025’s 60 wins, too. The 2026 finish: 84–78—43 more wins than two years earlier.
entry.summary: Three seasons. First 2024, then 2025, then 2026. Watch Chicago match a whole season of wins before halfway through the year.
entry.title: A Whole Season of Wins. By June.
